195: 
196:         # set all model params
197:         for p in model_params.keys():
198:             setattr(inst, p, model_params[p])
199: 
200:         return inst
201: 
202:     @classmethod
203:     def _byte2string(cls, model):
204:         for param_set in ['hyper_params', 'model_params']:
205:             for k in model[param_set].keys():
206:                 if type(model[param_set][k]) == type(b''):
207:                     model[param_set][k] = model[param_set][k].decode('utf-8')
208:         return model
209: 
210:     def to_hdf5(self, path):
211:         """
212:         Save model to a HDF5 file.
213:         Requires ``h5py`` http://docs.h5py.org/
214: 
215:         Parameters
216:         ----------
217:         path : str
218:             Full file path. File must not already exist.
219: 
220:         Raises
221:         ------
222:         FileExistsError
223:             If a file with the same path already exists.
224:         """
225:         if not HDF5_INSTALLED:
226:             raise ImportError(h5py_msg)
227: 
228:         d = self._to_dict(output='hdf5')
229:         hdftools.save_dict(d, path, 'data')
230: 
231:     @classmethod
232:     def from_hdf5(cls, path):
233:         """
234:         Load model from a HDF5 file.
235:         Requires ``h5py`` http://docs.h5py.org/
236: 
237:         Parameters
238:         ----------
239:         path : str
240:             Full path to file.
241: 
242:         Returns
243:         -------
244:         Model instance
245:         """
246:         if not HDF5_INSTALLED:
247:             raise ImportError(h5py_msg)
248: 
249:         model = hdftools.load_dict(path, 'data')
250:         model = cls._byte2string(model)
251: 
252:         for k in model['hyper_params'].keys():
253:             if isinstance(model['hyper_params'][k], str):
254:                 if model['hyper_params'][k] == 'None':
255:                     model['hyper_params'][k] = None
256: 
257:         return cls._organize_model(cls, model)
258: 
259:     def to_json(self, path):
260:         """
261:         Save model to a JSON file.
262: 
263:         Parameters
264:         ----------
265:         path : str
266:             Full file path.
267:         """
268: 
269:         d = self._to_dict(output='json')
270:         json.dump(d, open(path, 'w'))
271: 
272:     @classmethod
273:     def from_json(cls, path):
274:         """
275:         Load model from a JSON file.
276: 
277:         Parameters
278:         ----------
279:         path : str
280:             Full path to file.
281: 
282:         Returns
283:         -------
284:         Model instance
285:         """
286: 
287:         model = json.load(open(path, 'r'))
288:         model = cls._byte2string(model)
289: 
290:         # Convert the lists back to arrays
291:         for param_type in ['model_params', 'hyper_params']:
292:             for k in model[param_type].keys():
293:                 param = model[param_type][k]
294:                 if type(param) is list:
295:                     try:
296:                         arr = np.array(param)
297:                         if arr.dtype == object:
298:                             # Then maybe it was rather a list of arrays
299:                             # This is very hacky...
300:                             arr = [np.array(p) for p in param]
301:                     except ValueError:
302:                         arr = [np.array(p) for p in param]
303:                     model[param_type][k] = arr
304: 
305:         return cls._organize_model(cls, model)
306: 
307:     def to_pickle(self, path):
308:         """
309:         Save model to a pickle file.
310: 
311:         Parameters
312:         ----------
313:         path : str
314:             Full file path.
315:         """
316: 
317:         d = self._to_dict()
318:         pickle.dump(d, open(path, 'wb'), protocol=2)
319: 
320:     @classmethod
321:     def from_pickle(cls, path):
322:         """
323:         Load model from a pickle file.
324: 
325:         Parameters
326:         ----------
327:         path : str
328:             Full path to file.
329: 
330:         Returns
331:         -------
332:         Model instance
333:         """
334:         model = pickle.load(open(path, 'rb'))
335:         model = cls._byte2string(model)
336:         return cls._organize_model(cls, model)
